implementation_rationale: Keywords get a 3x multiplier (weight 21 vs 7) to make explicit user intent strongly influence injection without completely overriding the relevance ranking
Keywords don't bypass gates to preserve consistency with the existing scoring pipeline and avoid special-casing
Storing keywords as-is (not normalized at write time) keeps storage simple and defers normalization to query time
tradeoffs: Approach 3 was selected (user said 'approach 3' at transcript start), implying at least two other approaches were considered — details not visible in this transcript
Keywords boost scoring rather than bypassing gates: preserves fairness in ranking but means a keyword match alone can't guarantee injection
codebase_patterns: Injection scoring uses token overlap with weighted components (primaryOverlap * 7 baseline)
Memory status must be 'active' to pass injection gate (passesInjectionGate filters to StatusActive)

Manual vs generated memories are distinguished at creation time (AddManualRecord vs generator path)
